title: Precision of Quantile-Optimal Treatment Thresholds under Rough Conditional Censoring
banked_reason: The headline promised a sharp four-criterion frontier, but the delivered sound result is only a nonmatching bracket; rough-region rates, critical logarithms and the exact oracle-equality boundary remain open.

proof_attempt_summary: One D0 solve derived a sound partial bracket and the solved oracle-equality and separation regions; five textbook citation gaps were repaired through author-hosted sources and all five passed attested review. The sharp four-criterion frontier failed the kernel check: at beta=s=0.1 the lower n^(-2/7) and upper (log n/n)^(1/5) do not match, and critical logarithms and the exact boundary remain open. Independent validity review found no concrete bounded root fix and confirmed downgrade at incremental tier; Lean formalization was not entered.
tldr: Conditional followup can obscure the location of a treatment threshold that maximizes the marginal lower survival quartile even when treatment and followup positivity are uniform. The focal object is the original-record precision frontier indexed by event and censor smoothness: minimax absolute threshold error and minimax expected length of finite-sample honest connected intervals, compared with the same censored records carrying their true censor rates. The exponential censor clock and global quartile curvature are newly maintained benchmark restrictions with a normalized single-crossing submodel; neither fixes the censor-learning cost. Global curvature permits uniform finite-parent argmax and honest-interval transfer across the decision band. Local criterion noise and remote changes in the optimal quartile are distinct channels. A cube-root oracle benchmark, a pooled-bin upper bound and a normalized affine-mixture rough-corner converse give certified finite-sample benchmark bounds. The full rough-region rates, critical logarithms and oracle-equality boundary remain the first-class open question.
gap: Estimator-specific quantile-policy limit theory and quantile-value learning rates do not determine the original-record cost of rough conditional followup or finite-parent threshold interval length. Existing rough functional frontiers use different likelihood channels.
fill: Determine four minimax criteria on one fixed primitive class. Observable joint correction and bias-aware inversion must be paired with normalized marked-law alternatives retaining strong quartile geometry in every realization.
